name: Bisque
body:
Station and Complexity entremetier 4, line cook 4, poissonier 4

Flavor Profiles texture, umami, temperature, salty
Additional Ingredients sour or spicy

EFFECT

Duration 1 round/level; Serving Size 1
Saving Throw none (harmless); Spell Resistance no (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

A bisque is a thick, creamy soup made with shellfish and thickened by a paste made from their shells.

When consumed, it grants the ability to supernaturally control water, as the spell, for the duration.

Additional ingredients increase the duration to 1 minute/level, then 10 minutes per level.
